storage.title: How to Store Tea Properly
storage.excerpt: Expert tips: temperature, humidity, light, and other factors affecting tea quality.
storage.content: Proper tea storage is an art that preserves all the flavor and aromatic properties of the beverage. Basic rules: keep tea in airtight packaging, protect from light and moisture, store at room temperature. Different varieties have different requirements: pu-erh needs ventilation, while green tea is better kept in the refrigerator.

section1.title: 1. General Provisions
section1.content: BoosterTea LLC (hereinafter — the Company) is committed to protecting the privacy of personal data of website visitors. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and how we protect it.

section2.title: 2. Data We Collect

section2.item4: Technical data (IP address, browser type, cookies)

section3.title: 3. How We Use Data
section3.content: Your data is used exclusively for processing orders, delivering goods, improving our service, and sending promotional information (with your consent).

section4.title: 4. Data Protection
section4.content: We use modern data protection methods, including SSL encryption and secure data storage. Your data is not shared with third parties without your consent, except as required by Ukrainian law.

section5.title: 5. Your Rights
section5.content: In accordance with Ukrainian law on Personal Data Protection, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your data. To do so, please contact us using the provided contact information.
